answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a financial river flowing toward validators, requiring agents to bond collateral to gain network influence. To prevent a Sybil spiral where cheap identities overwhelm the system, the mechanism enforces a capital cost proportional to participation. Every malicious comet of fake nodes must stake significant value, ensuring that identity creation is economically bounded by the assets an attacker is willing to forfeit if caught behaving dishonestly.
